metadata.description: Jason Matthew's personal Claude Code skills marketplace.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Cross-provider adversarial plan/design-doc review via OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Sol) plus a blind Opus reviewer: verdict-loop protocol, atomic chain guard, cross-repo decision-gate log.

plugins.name: domain-modeling
plugins.description: Actively build and sharpen a project's ubiquitous language — an opinionated CONTEXT.md glossary — by challenging terms, disambiguating overloaded words, and stress-testing domain relationships. Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Bundle of the gates units: installs gates-docs, gates-models, gates-config and gates-signing together. Ships no hooks of its own; install a unit alone to take only that guard.

plugins.name: gates-config
plugins.description: PostToolUse JSON-config guard: re-parses settings.json, settings.local.json and .mcp.json after an edit or shell write and reports a syntax error, which Claude Code otherwise swallows by silently dropping the config it cannot parse. Runs a committed macOS binary; does not run elsewhere.

plugins.name: gates-docs
plugins.description: Docs-drift commit gate and docs-consolidation trigger. Denies a git commit that changes code without staging its covering docs (per-plugin README/CLAUDE.md pairs, or the nearest README/CLAUDE/AGENTS walking up), with a docs-sync:ack escape. A never-blocking Stop/UserPromptSubmit pair counts commits since the .docs-sync record and nudges toward the /docs-consolidate skill. GATES_DISABLE turns either off.

plugins.name: gates-models
plugins.description: Model-tiering gates for delegation. Denies a high-fan-out Workflow script with no per-agent model: override and asks before a denylisted built-in named workflow; denies an ad-hoc Agent dispatch that omits model unless the agent type pins one in frontmatter. model-guard:ack bypasses; GATES_DISABLE turns either off. Runs a committed macOS binary with a node fallback.

plugins.name: gates-signing
plugins.description: PostToolUseFailure nudge for a git commit or SSH push that failed because the 1Password SSH agent is locked or unreachable: tells Claude to ask the user to unlock rather than retry or change git/SSH config. Never blocks.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Manual /handoff skill — writes a structured resume doc on demand, auto-loads it on next session.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Capture layer for a weekly self-healing review: one input-free, redacted JSON line per tool outcome, denial and session start, tagged with harness version. No stdout, no network.

plugins.name: ship-gate
plugins.description: Stop-hook gate against trail-off: detects unpushed commits at turn end and injects an agent-directed nudge to review and finish the branch.

plugins.name: writing-artifacts
plugins.description: Positive writing system for durable written artifacts (READMEs, ADRs, PR descriptions, docs, runbooks): reader-expectation prose, Diátaxis document jobs, plain-language structure. Complements reply-style rules in global CLAUDE.md.
